modernRectification.displacementStatus: Source signs, extrema, repeated states and relative intermediate heights retained; exact normalized values are separately declared modern rectification, not measured original numbers.
modernRectification.vectorStatus: Source direction and short/medium/long hierarchy retained; exact native lengths are uncalibrated modern regularization, not measured speed units.
modernRectification.interpolation: Native sampled cubic Hermite connectors through all independent ball anchors; stationary connections exactly straight from the reached front. No global sine or cosine generator.
modernRectification.textLayout: Number labels remain tied to each dot x coordinate; offsets expanded to clear vectors at 640px. Five separated baselines flattened from minor scan skew.
modernRectification.arrivalTimes: Only six source timestamp snapshots bound arrival intervals; no between-snapshot arrival time is fabricated.
